name: adjoint
description: Full scalar-per-cell epsilon gradient of a two-probe loss in a periodic dielectric box (docs/FDTDX_MATCHED_FULL_GRADIENT.md fixture at 128 steps).
boundaries: all six periodic, zero Bloch phase

source.note: Additive Ex kick at one vacuum cell after the E update; kick[n]=waveform((n+1)*dt). FDTDX injects -C*inv_eps*profile[n] at time n*dt, so profile=-kick/C at the fixed inv_eps=1 source cell.

design_variables: all 64^3 cells except the source cell (gradient reported on the full array; source-cell entry is zero by construction in TorchFDTD and in FDTDX)
meep: Meep is excluded: its adjoint is a frequency-domain method with different semantics.
